answer: Require every agent to join a small staking circle: members lock a bond and vouch for each other, and the bond is slashed if any member cheats. Trust spreads like a spiral — each verified circle links to others through shared members, so a lone identity has no weight until real peers stake on it. A sybil farmer must fund a separate bond for every fake identity, which quickly costs more than the rewards. An umber flag marks circles with identical behavior for extra review, while a sparrow — an honest newcomer — can still enter cheaply by joining one real circle and proving itself over time.
